Move to the Right Region · Floor Edition

A walking quiz across four landscape walls and a projected floor compass. Read a question, choose a region, and follow the floor route when the answer is revealed. Edit the quiz, then play it across the full five-surface output.

Floor edition: 8640 × 3240 output. Four 2160 × 1080 walls occupy the top row; a 2160 × 2160 floor occupies x=2160, y=1080 directly below wall 2. The other lower areas are black. Use calibration, rotation and mirroring to check the installed projector mapping. The facilitator confirms choices; there is no floor-position sensing. The original recorded sample voices and sounds are retained. Custom text keeps the original browser-voice fallback. Edits can be shared as a link or carried in a downloaded HTML copy. Test alignment on the physical display before use.
